reviewedRevision: 646e368 plus the rework in this commit
process: Lean final review at the user's request: the known 3-section shortfall went straight to a retrofit, followed by one independent review round. It passed with no BLOCKING or MEDIUM findings and was released unchanged after one clean-worktree run and the browser check.
independentProbes: The reviewer's own reaction-limited pilot (public getState only, 60 Hz, 5 seeds with reaction jitter) cleared 100 of 100 river runs at 0.25 s and 89 of 100 at 0.35 s: levels 1-16 cleared 79 of 80, mastery levels 17-20 cleared 10 of 20, and every failure was a missed flag the pilot never paddled back for (mastery needs every flag), not hull loss. Forty-two blind patterns, including up/down alternation at 0.5-4 s with and without strokes or brake, cleared at most 16.7% of levels 3-20. The five back-current levels cannot be cleared without paddle strokes. Final states matched at 30, 60 and 120 Hz, a hostile fuzz ended exactly once with no NaN, broken progress stores were safe, no level loses hull in the first 3 s of idle play, and colour is never the only cue.

findings.observation: Only 3 sections, with no select or continue, and a key-prompt autopilot. There are now 20 data-driven rivers (teaching 1-8, combination 9-15, mastery 16-20) with currents, whirlpools, weirs, rock gates, back-currents and flags, accurate EN/ZH tips, a river select and env.progress continue; overlays no longer cover the water, the stamina bar has a notch and Ready/Rest text, a Space press during cooldown is buffered, and the 979-line file is split into five modules.

openNotes: Mastery levels 17-20 are demanding at 0.35 s because every flag is required; a missed flag costs roughly 12-25 s of paddling back, which the 'Flag missed: paddle back (Left)' prompt guides.
The brake is helpful but optional, so the 'Brake...' tips on levels 2, 10 and 19 slightly overstate it.
A Space tap can be lost if a host calls update with a dt smaller than 1/120 s; the shipped host always steps at 1/120 s, so this cannot happen in the app.
Level 15 is the longest river, about 71-86 s for the reviewer's pilot.

browser.method: Official Claude in Chrome extension, local server; real clicks on Start and the language toggle, synthetic in-page keys; only DOM text and the canvas were read.
observed: English: Start opened level 1 of 20 with flags 0/4 (need 3), the stamina bar with a Ready label, hull boxes and the tip 'Arrows steer. Take 3 of 4 flags, then stop in the dock.' over an unobscured river.
Steering up overshot the first flag; the status line then read 'Flag missed: paddle back (Left)', the dock showed LOCKED as text, and drifting into the next flag raised the count to 1/4 with hull 3.
Chinese 390 px phone frame (388 px inner, no horizontal overflow): level 1 in Chinese with touch buttons 上, 下, 左, 右, 划桨 and 减速.
Not covered in the browser: a dock win and a hull loss; the reviewer's pilot and the quality tests cover them.
